source_text.body:
Redesign a landing page and ship it from a GitHub link
The author had Claude Design produce a high-fidelity prototype for a Docker tool's landing page from a GitHub link, then Claude Code implemented it for launch.
·
Nov 9, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
CC
Claude Code
What they did
The author gave Claude Design only a GitHub link for a Docker management tool. Claude chose the visual style and interaction logic itself and produced a high-fidelity HTML prototype. The author then adjusted local details through short chat instructions, and Claude Code turned the prototype into code for launch.
How it went
The author says the project went from design to launch in only a few conversations, which shortened development a lot. The source is a short summary, so it gives no detailed metrics or failures.
Worth knowing
This page is a brief summary that points to a V2EX post, so check that original for prompts and details.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Read the repo at [GitHub URL] and the landing page design or prototype I have at [link or file]. Implement the new landing page in this codebase, matching the design with responsive layouts and the project's existing stack. Stop when it runs locally without errors, and show me a summary of the changes before you commit or push anything.
Original source: https://www.80aj.com/2026/04/25/claude-design-ai-workflow/
